source.title: A traceable observation — public synthetic fixture
source.text:
[Page 1]
Field notebook 🧭 — café

This practice procedure keeps an observation connected to a stated rule and recorded evidence. It does not establish real-world safety.

Procedure for a traceable observation:
1. Read the supplied observation.
2. Compare the observation with the supplied rule.
3. Record the decision and its evidence.

sources.title: A recorded message trace — public synthetic fixture
sources.text:
[Page 2]

In this recorded trace, Build request precedes Send request. Send request precedes Receive response. No other relationship is recorded. The trace describes order only; it does not establish timing or delivery guarantees.
